ruling.explanation:
Both parties agree on the arithmetic, and on this record it is correct. Same trip: EV-TRIP-02835, EV-GPS-02835 and EV-FARE-02835 all carry trip_id TRP-02835 and reconcile on timestamps, so the rider's POL-RD-08(a) burden is discharged. Deviation: EV-GPS-02835 (weight 1.0, COMPLETE) records trace_distance_km 92.0 km against the booked optimal_distance_km of 22.0 km on EV-TRIP-02835, an excess of 70.0 km — 318.18% of optimal. Both POL-RD-01 tests pass (over 20% and over 0.8 km) and the excess is additionally MATERIAL (over 50% and over 8.0 km), so the POL-RD-06 driver_profile check is required. The trace governs over trip_record.actual_distance_km, which may not be cited for the threshold test. The trace is clean for policy purposes — 834 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100% coverage, max_gap_sec 0.0 — so no limb (a)–(c) of POL-RD-07 fires, the deviation stands on the trace alone, and POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged. The driver's statement that the rider was unresponsive and gave no destination is not a rider-requested detour: EV-CHAT-02835 carries zero messages, so POL-RD-04 has no message, no timestamp and no waypoint_hint, and the clause is unavailable. No traffic advisory covers the trip — EV-ADVIS-02835-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 — so POL-RD-03 cannot be run and any external-cause assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08/POL-RD-13. No pickup or dropoff amendment is recorded, so POL-RD-05 does not apply, and the vehicle is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not apply; the 22.0 km booked optimal is the baseline. On the METERED fare of EV-FARE-02835, recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 × 22.0 + 0.28 × 30.0) × 2.0 surge) + 0.80 platform fee = 58.20, with the surge multiplier read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier. Charged_total was 224.12, so the refund is 224.12 − 58.20 = 165.92, rounded up to 165.95 — 74.03% of charged_total, below the 90% full-refund share, and well above the 0.50 de minimis floor; the ordinary outcome would be PARTIAL_REFUND of 165.95. There is no ERP, toll or surcharge line to correct under POL-RD-09, and no billing-integrity defect. No repeat-deviation pattern is established under POL-RD-06 (deviation_flags_90d 0, 0/300 ratio 0.00), so the POL-RD-06(b) uplift and POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral are not available, and the rider's profile does not engage the POL-RD-08 corroboration overlay (deviation_claims_60d 0). WHY THIS ESCALATES: the refund computed under POL-RD-02, 165.92, exceeds the SGD 150.00 ceiling in POL-RD-10(6). That is a mandatory escalation trigger and it is terminal — it replaces the monetary ruling, no refund or charge issues, and the disputed amount of SGD 144.00 is held rather than collected or refunded. Confidence is 0.90, above the 0.70 floor, so POL-RD-10(1) is not in play; the escalation rests solely on POL-RD-10(6). The deciding evidence — EV-GPS-02835, EV-TRIP-02835 and EV-FARE-02835 — is all at weight_multiplier 1.0, so no POL-GEN-02(2) discount applies and no impaired artifact carries any finding. The record is complete and no further evidence is needed: the rider's entitlement to 165.95 is established on the evidence, and the human reviewer needs only to authorise release of the amount the ceiling refers up. No referral attaches — no clause in this category produces one on these facts.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and 3 of the 4 drafts agreed on this ruling, so it is carried, not unanimous (vote agreement 0.75).
